PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PGIMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, which is 16 September 2026. There is no separate application deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Senior Resident post is M.S. (General Surgery).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for the Senior Resident position at PGIMER.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for OBC (43 years) and SC (45 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident post will be as per PGI Rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. Specific documents like ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates (if applicable) are also required.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: The job type for this Senior Resident position is Ad-hoc.
